MEET CELEBRITY COSMETIC DENTIST DR. V

Known to her patients as “Dr. V,” Dr. Victoria Veytsman is one of the most in-demand celebrity cosmetic dentists in the country. With practices in New York City and Los Angeles, she specializes in cosmetic dentistry, anti-aging dentistry, and dento-facial aesthetics—a highly specialized field where beauty, wellness, and oral health come together.

Dr. Veytsman is the youngest-ever graduate of NYU Dental, and her artistry, skill, and gentle approach have made her the go-to dentist for A-list clients around the world. Her passion for smile makeovers is rooted in her background in art, allowing her to blend science and aesthetics to create truly life-changing results.

From first consultation to final result, Dr. V is known for her meticulous technique, warm bedside manner, and deep commitment to patient comfort. Her work isn’t just about creating beautiful smiles—it’s about tranforming lives by helping people feel confident, empowered, and seen.

Nationally Recognized

In the media

With a reputation that spans New York City and Los Angeles, Dr. Victoria Veytsman of Cosmetic Dental Studios has become one of the most recognized names in cosmetic dentistry—both in practice and in the media.

Dr. Veytsman’s expertise and transformative results have earned her features in leading national and international outlets. She has been spotlighted as a celebrity makeover dentist on the TLC network, and profiled in prestigious publications such as Allure, Brides, Men’s Health, Social Life Magazine, and the Daily Mail, among others.

A respected voice in the beauty and wellness space, Dr. Veytsman also serves as the Beauty Ambassador for Haute Living in both the Los Angeles and Manhattan, markets. Her media presence reflects her deep commitment to innovation, aesthetics, and patient-centered care.

Whether she's behind the scenes of a high-profile makeover or featured in a major beauty publication, Dr. Veytsman is consistently recognized as one of the top cosmetic dentists in the field.
